editorial:
Imagine being a rookie cop who follows every single rule in the book, only to be told your new boss is a dirty cop who needs to be spied on. That is exactly what you get here. You will see a great clash between a young officer who believes in the law and a veteran leader who thinks the law is just a suggestion when you are trying to catch a killer. The vibe is tense and gritty, making you wonder who the real bad guy is as the story unfolds. It is a cat-and-mouse game, but the roles keep switching, which keeps you guessing about where the loyalty actually lies.

The acting is top-notch and the tension builds up perfectly. While some parts of the plot feel a bit slow, the big payoffs make it worth the wait. If you like stories about morality and grey areas, you will love this.
endingExplained: You will find out that the veteran team leader was actually playing a long game to catch a much bigger fish. The twist is that the rookie officer ends up becoming just like his mentor to get justice. In the final scenes, the truth about the corruption comes out, and the bad guys are finally taken down. It ends with a heavy feeling as the rookie realizes that sometimes you have to break the rules to do the right thing.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime thrillers with a twist.
